info.name: Channel Connect - SMS API
info.description: SMS send and receive requests against Channel Connect. Use local,sms-http-two-lines,sms-web-receive to continuously import the direct GoIP8 HTML inbox using SMS_GOIP_IPADDRESS, SMS_GOIP_USER and SMS_GOIP_PASS (Basic Auth). This does not require hosted API keys or changes to the gateway SMS-server destination. Set smsApiToken to SMS_API_TOKEN, edit recipient in the send JSON body, and select accountId for the SIM. Receive waits until a matching local inbox message exists; set Postman's request timeout to 0 for unlimited waiting. receiveCursor advances for new-message polling. Receive-all lists retained history across configured SIMs, with optional accountId/sender filters. inboxCursor is independent: manually set it to nextCursor when hasMore=true. Existing HTML inbox entries are imported without historic automatic replies; repeated snapshots are deduplicated. No gateway SMS is deleted. See docs/goip-sms.md for configuration and firmware limits. 202 means queued, not delivered.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get("smsApiToken")) throw new Error("Set smsApiToken to SMS_API_TOKEN.");
pm.test("SMS accepted for queueing", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); });

if (pm.response.code === 202) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Submission has messageId and status", function () { pm.expect(body.messageId).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(body.status).to.be.a("string"); }); pm.collectionVariables.set("messageId", body.messageId); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Inbox page includes messages and hasMore", function () { pm.expect(body.messages).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(body.hasMore).to.be.a("boolean"); }); }
